Commentary.Commentary: Pakistan bowled well throughout the game but just didn't take their chances. Nearly seven run out chances missed with a couple of dropped catches as well which added to their misery. Arshad Iqbal and Muhammad Musa stood out for them, claiming 7 wickets between them and were brilliant. It's a good pitch to bat on but Pakistan will have to apply themselves to scale down the target. The pressure of a knockout will play another role. It promises to be a riveting second half, do join us in a short while.

Excellent effort by India to post a big total. One must say that after losing their way in the middle, they did well to reach here. After electing to bat, they started off well. Shaw and Kalra rode their luck to score 40-odd runs each but gave too many chances to gift away their wickets. Bowling changes worked somewhat for Pakistan as they got three quick wickets in the middle to reduce India to 166/5. Anukul Roy took some pressure off Gill and contributed well lower down the order. But it was that man, Shubman Gill again who got to the magical figures, the first Indian to reach the three digit mark in the tournament. He paced his innings perfectly and batted well with the tail to take India to a respectable total.

Free Hit - Caught! And it's a stunning catch by the Pakistan skipper, Hasan Khan. Fuller length ball on off, Shubman Gill tries powering it down the ground but mistimes it in the air. Hasan in the deep takes a terrific diving catch but it won't count. Strangely, they take only a run. INDIA END ON 272/9!

DROPPED! NO BALL! IT"S ALL HAPPENING! Century for Shubman Gill! What a knock by the young man against the arch rivals at a grand stage. Fullish and on off, Gill smashes it in the air towards long off where the fielder drops. It's called a no ball and they take a couple. Superb moment for him. He has one more ball left to face and it will be a Free Hit...
Too full and on off, squeezed out through covers for a single. Gill gets the strike, cheers all around in the stadium.

OUT! Trapped in front! Musa cannons in a terrific yorker, right in the blockhole, too quick for the number 10 batsman. Shiva fails to dig it out and is hit on the boots. They appeal and the finger goes up. Can Ishan Porel take a single on the next ball? Gill is on 99!

In the air...safe! A length ball angling into the batsman, Gill tries to heave it over the leg side but gets a top edge. It balloons in the air and falls safely as the cover fielder was on the edge of the circle. A single taken. On 99, Shubman!
Risky! Pitches it up and outside off, it's pushed square of the wicket on the off side and they cross. The point fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end, otherwise there would have been a run out.
OUT! Gone! Musa spears in a fuller length ball on middle, nearly a yorker, Mavi whips it across the line, fails to keep it down and Imran inside the ring at mid-wicket snaps a sharp catch.
High full toss outside off, Gill whacks it to long off and runs a couple. 14 from the over!
Confidently pushes a full ball to covers and rotates the strike. Sensible.

FOUR! Mavi is playing a useful hand here! Afridi overdoes his line and length this time, darts in a short ball on middle and leg, Mavi pulls it disdainfully through backward square leg for a boundary. No chance for fine leg.
FOUR! Beautiful shot by a number 9! Very full and outside off, Mavi reaches out for it with an open face of the bat and rifles it over point for a boundary.
Plays it with soft hands to the leg side and takes a run.
Tucks a length ball through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.

Nearly a run out. Short and angling into the batsman, Mavi tries to heave across the line but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Wants a single, strangely, is sent back. He slips a bit but makes it safely.
Width on offer outside off, slapped to sweeper cover for one.
Fullish and on off, Mavi pushes it to point and steals a run. 250 up for India!
Fetches a short ball from outside off and plays a rocket-pull over mid-wicket. Fine diving effort near the rope to save a run. Gill moves to 92!
Steers it through point for a couple.
Forces it down to long off for a brace.

OUT! Chops it on. Shaheen follows the batsman down the leg side with a back of a length delivery. Nagarkoti is cramped for room as he tries to defend. But it takes the bottom half of his bat and disturbs the stumps.
Short and on middle, the batsman aims for the upper cut but misses.
A low full toss on middle, pushed to covers and Nagarkoti looked for a run. Sent back and would have been run out had the fielder found the stumps with his shy at the striker's end.
Spears in a full ball on middle, it's safely kept out to covers.
Steams in from around the wicket for Nagarkoti and bowls a fast full toss outside off, the batsman pushes and misses.
Short and angling away from the batsman outside off, it's dabbed down to third man for one.
Attempts a yorker but it turns out to be a full toss, Gill punches it down the ground to long off and retains strike.
Fast and furious, short on off, it's fended down towards third man. The fielder in the deep made a good stop to prevent a boundary. A couple taken.

FOUR! Delightful shot! All in the wrists. Class written all over this shot by Gill. He leans forward to a full ball and creams it through extra cover for a boundary. Gill is single-handedly sailing the Indian ship to safety.
Too full and around off, pushed out through covers for a single.

OUT! Roy walks even before the finger goes up. A well-directed short ball, around leg at 145 kph, Roy tries to pull but it kisses his gloves and settles into the gloves of the keeper. He appeals and the umpire raises his finger. End of a handy partnership for India.
Comes running down the track to a full ball and squeezes it out to third man for a run.
Walks down the track to a full ball and drives it to mid off for a brisk run.
FOUR! Wow, shades of Virat Kohli in that shot! Plenty of bottom hand involved in that pull shot as Gill nails it to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Turns it off his pads to square leg for a run.
Takes the pace off the ball and bowls it on a shorter length around off, Roy tries to run it down to third man but gets a thin outside edge. It doesn't carry to the keeper.
Shortish again, outside off, flat-batted down to mid off for one.
Short of a length ball on off, pulled down to wide long on for a quick couple. Pressurized the fielder in the deep and got the misfield.
Plays it down to the off side, in the gap at covers, and they cross.
This time stays back to a full ball outside off and drills it through mid off for a single.
Once again the batsman gets down the track and pushes it back.
Walks down the track to a full ball and pushes it to the bowler.
Yorker length on off, dug out through covers for one.
Jumps out of the crease to take it on the full and forces it down to long on for a run.
Back of a length ball on off, tapped down to point for one.
Fuller and on off, driven down to mid off for a quick single.
Slower delivery, on a good length outside off, Roy inside edges his attempted heave to deep square leg for a run.
Wide! Short and down the leg side, it's left alone. 50-run stand comes up!

Direct hit would have been tight! Shortish and on middle, Gill mistimes his pull to mid-wicket and looks for a run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. That would have been curtains for Gill, the replays show.
Back of a length ball on off, it's guided down to third man for a run.
A length ball on middle and leg, bunted to mid off for a sharp single.
Finishes it with a yorker, around off, Roy fails to dig it out and that wasn't too far away from the off pole.
A low full toss on middle, Roy smashes it straight back and the bowler dives to his right to make the stop.
Pushes a full ball down to long off for a single.
Fires one on the pads, once again Roy plays it wide of short fine leg for one.
Full flighted on middle, tickled through wide mid on for a run.
Quicker fuller on the pads, nudged towards short fine leg for a brisk single.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it right back. The mid on fielder does the mopping up and they take a run.
FOUR! Fine shot! Shaheen angles in a length ball on off, Roy clears his front leg and slogs it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Wide called for height. Another bouncer, this one goes way over the head of the batsman.
Bouncer around middle and leg, Gill ducks.

FOUR! Not quite timed it but still a boundary. A pitched up ball outside off, plenty of width on offer, Anukul latches onto it and goes hard at it. Not from the middle of the bat but it still has enough to cross the fence. 200 up for India!
Angling away from the batsman, on a length, Gill mistimes his shot in front of point for a run. 300 runs in the tournament for Shubman.
Fullish and outside off, driven on the up towards mid off.
Sees the charge from the batsman and bangs in another bouncer. Anukul ducks at the last moment.
Bouncer around leg, Roy ducks underneath it.
Fullish and on off, pushed towards the cover region.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Width on offer outside off, Roy camps back and throws everything at it. Connects well and smashes it over covers for a boundary.
Full and angling around middle and leg, helped through mid-wicket for a run.
Fullish and on off, driven back to the bowler.
Wide! Musa returns into the attack and bowls a gentle loosener first up. Down the leg side and Gill fails to flick.
Fires one full on middle, it's dug out to the off side.
Very full and on off, driven firmly to sweeper cover for one.
Shows a little bit of footwork and drives a full ball through point for a single.
Taps it with gentle hands to point and pinches a single.
Flighted and full on middle, played down to mid on.
Too full and on off, pushed off the front foot to extra cover.
Too full and on middle, forced down the ground for a couple of runs. Arshad Iqbal is bowled out, 3/51 for him.
Angling in a full length ball on off, defended from the back foot.
This time the bowler goes slower through the air and lands it full around off, Roy pushes it to covers and looks for a run. Sent back.
Back of a length ball on off, it's pulled firmly to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Cheeky! Short in length and outside off, Gill stays back and just uses the pace of the bowler to guide it down to the third man boundary.
Good length ball on off, punched to sweeper cover. The fielder in the deep moved across to his right to stop the ball and they collected a couple of runs.
FOUR! Pressure releasing shot! A loopy full ball on off, Roy advances down the track and chips it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Full and on off, defended back.
Short this time, around off, cut from the back foot to backward point.
Flatter and turning into the batsman from outside off, it's clipped on the leg side where the mid-wicket fielder misfields and allows a couple.
Leans forward to a full ball and pushes it to the off side. The bowler does the fielding.
Goes on the back foot to a shortish ball and punches it to mid-wicket.
Goes short and lands it around middle and off, Roy gently plays it down to square leg for a single. Another tidy over by Pakistan!
Slower one, full and around off, Roy flicks it on the leg side but not in the gap.
Pitches it up and around off, Roy pushes it off his front foot to mid off. Shades of Raina in that shot.
Short and around leg, the batsman ducks easily.
Too full and outside off, dug out to covers.

Fifty for Shubman Gill, he continues his rich vein of form. Full and angling into the batsman, Gill bunts it down the ground for a single. He needs to bat long and deep if India have to post a big total on the board.
Lunges to a slower full ball outside off and defends it with soft hands.
Quicker, flatter and on middle, punched back to the bowler.
A touch flatter and down the leg side, played to square leg again. Good pressure bowling by Pakistan.
Roy plays it with the spin but finds the square leg fielder.
Slower through the air this time, full and on off, it's forced down to long off for a single.
Loopy full ball on off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
On a length around off, moving back in, Gill works it around in front of square leg for a run to end the over.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Roy goes back and and taps it down behind square leg for a single.
Effort ball, the bowler lets out a grunt and digs in a shortish ball on off, Gill stands back and pulls it down to fine leg for one.
Probably attempts a yorker but ends up slipping a full toss on the pads, Roy eases it through square leg for one.
Fullish and on off, driven back past the bowler to mid off.

OUT! Soft dismissal! Another one bites the dust for India. What a time for Pakistan, they have now removed the top 5 opposition batsmen. A length delivery drifting down the leg side, Abhishek tries to flick but gets a fine tickle behind to the keeper. Nazir catches the ball and throws up in celebration. The finger has also gone up. India in a spot of bother now. Anukul Roy strides in next to join Gill.
Gets forward and drives it firmly to short extra cover. The fielder misfields and they steal a run.
Presses forward to a full ball and strokes it to long off for a run. Sensible batting.
FOUR! Fires in a quicker one down the leg side, too full in length, Gill kneels and nails his sweep behind square leg for a boundary. Fantastic wrist work.
Uses his feet to get down the track and knocks it down to long on for a single.
Flatter and outside off, it's pushed back to the bowler.
Flighted and full outside off, driven through covers for an easy two.
Short again, Gill looks to scoop this over to third man but is beaten.
Bags this short on the pads of Sharma who flicks it way to deep square leg for one.
Fuller this time, Sharma drives it to covers.
Bouncer! Abhishek ducks under it.
Sharma works this to mid on.

It's been driven superbly through the covers.
On the legs of Riyan who plays it to short fine leg for a quick run.
On the pads of Gill who flicks it away on the leg side for a run.
Similar ball and simliar result. Gill cuts this one too behind backward point.
Short ball, Gill cuts it away past backward point to come back for the second.
Gill drives this to the cover fielder.
Gill drives this through covers for one.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Short ball, Parag goes for the pull but misses the ball.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

OUT! Change of bowling has done the trick for Pakistan. They brought back their strike bower and he has struck for them. Short ball outside off, Desai looks to cut this over the point fielder but only manages to give it to the fielder stationed at backward point. Saad Khan jumps to take a good catch. Throws it high up to celebrate the wicket. Much needed breakthrough for Pakistan.
Bowls this full, Gill hits it through covers for a run.
Arshad Iqbal to bowl.
Desai works this to the mid-wicket fielder.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.

The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Floated ball, Desai drives this past mid off to retain strike.
Desai gives it back to the bowler.

Desai has punched the ball off the back foot.
Tossed up, Gill works it through mid on for a run. That brings up the 50-run stand for this pair. It has come off 62 balls. Good going.
Short ball, Gill rocks back and hits it past mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Gill has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.

Good result for Pakistan. No damage done. Gill gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over mid-wicket for just one.
No ball signalled for overstepping. Short ball, Gill cuts it to point. Free Hit up next!
Desai drives it this time past mid off for one.

The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Desai drives this through the covers.

The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. This time Gill on the charge. Tossed up ball, in line of the stumps, Gill flicks it away past mid-wicket to the fence.
FOUR! Just about time! Slow ball, around off, Desai goes on his knees and slog sweeps this over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Desai has driven that ball straight back to the bowler again.
Desai has punched the ball off the back foot to the bowler.
It's been driven superbly through the covers by Gill. They pick up a single.
Worked through mid on by the batsman.
Tossed up, Desai drives it past mid off to move to the other end.
Gill has flicked the ball off his pads.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Gill hits this to the mid-wicket fielder.
Slow and short. Asif gets away with it. Desai pulls this to deep mid-wicket for one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Pitched up, Gill works it through mid on for a run.
Floated delivery, Gill plays it to mid on to pick up the fourth single of the over.
Gill has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Tossed up, Desai drives this past mid off for another run.
Gill punches this on the off side to rotate strike.
Length around off, Desai punches it on the off side for one.
Pitched up, on middle and leg, Desai works it through mid-wicket for another run.
Short again, Gill pulls it in front of square on the leg side for one.
Good running. Pitched up this time, Gill works it through mid-wicket again for another two runs.
Short ball, Gill pulls it away through mid-wicket for a brace.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Pitched up ball, around the legs of Gill. He flicks this away through mid on for another boundary.
Ali Zaryab comes in to bowl.
Slow in line of the stumps, Desai defends this.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Short ball, Gill pulls this past mid-wicket for one.
Gill hits this back to the bowler.
Slow ball, around off, Gill goes for the flick and gets a leading edge to this. The ball falls short of the mid off fielder.
Starts off with a full one. Desai works it to mid on for a run.
Mohammad Taha to bowl now.
FOUR! Shot! Short ball, Gill pulls this in front of square, not far from the fielder at short mid-wicket and the ball races away for a boundary.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full again, Gill works this to the mid-wicket fielder.
Gill flicks this to mid-wicket.
Fuller in length, Gill hits this to mid on.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Desai hits this back to the bowler.
Desai drives this to the mid off fielder.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Drags his length back, Desai cuts this past point to pick up a brace.
Pitched up, Gill hits this through covers for one more.
Tossed up, Desai works this to mid on for one.
Desai has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Wide. The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Desai is off the mark. Guides this to third man and they come back for the second.
Bouncer first up! Desai does well to leave it.
Harvik Desai walks in next.

OUT! Pakistan get another one! Great seam position from Musa and he gets his man. Length around off, straightens after pitching, Kalra plays away from his body and gets an inside edge to this. The ball just misses the off stump and goes to the keeper who has a simple catch. The Pakistanis are overjoyed by this. We have a contest here.
The batsman attempts to hook that one but fails to make contact.
Slower ball, Kalra hits this hard to long on for just one.
Tossed up again, Gill works it through mid on for another run.
Floated ball, Kalra drives it through mid off for one.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Kalra hits it straight to the bowler.
Tossed up, Gill hits it towards mid on for a run.
Hassan Khan to bowl now.
Bouncer! Kalra ducks to evade it.
Gill is off the mark. Punches this ball past point to pick up his first run.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery.
Drinks have been called on for after the fall of the wicket. Shubman Gill is next in to bat. He is averaging over 100 in this tournament and is the batsman in form for India.

OUT! After four failed attempts from Pakistan, they find the timber. Shaw has to depart. The openers kept giving the fielders multiple chances to run them out and finally they have taken one. Back of a length ball, Kalra jumps to bunt it down near the surface. They go for the quick run and Musa runs quickly to the ball. He picks it up and stretches to break the stumps as Shaw dives in. The umpire goes upstairs and the replays show us that Shaw was inside the crease but his bat was in the air. It never touched down even once to be given not out. He has to take the long walk back.
Third umpire is been refereed for a run out chance. Shaw wanted the quick single and the bowler hits the stumps. Could be very close.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.

Slow ball in line of the stumps and Kalra pops this straight back past the bowler. Doesn't time it well enough but they get two. The ball is thrown back but the keeper fails to collect it. Shaw comes back for the third run. Had the keeper hit, Shaw was out. Another run out chance goes begging.
Muhammad Musa comes in to bowl.
Kalra hits it past point to retain strike.
Outside off, Shaw opens the face of his bat to help it to third man. One more.
Short ball, Kalra works this to third man for one more.
Shaw guides this to third man for one.
Pitched up, Kalra hits it to mid off and they scamper for a run.
Kalra lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Wide. The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire signals a wide.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Slow ball, Kalra plays it with soft hands. The ball goes to the slip fielder on the bounce.
Nice sound of the bat but hit straight to the point fielder.
Kalra guides this to wide first slip.
Overpitched ball in line of the stumps, Shaw plays this to mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Well played. Short again, Shaw picks up length quickly and pulls this towards mid-wicket. There is protection in the deep which means only one run.
Drags his length back, Kalra goes for the pull, doesn't connect well enough. The ball goes to the short fine leg region and they pick up a run.
Outside off, Kalra cuts it to point again.
Kalra hits this to point.
On the legs of Shaw who flicks it away for one.
Outside off, Shaw cuts it past the point region to pick up two runs.
Arshad Iqbal to bowl another spell.
Changing his length well. Yorker this time and Kalra digs it out in time.
Short again! Kalra does well to leave it.
Good ball from Afridi. Swings into Kalra after pitching. Full length around off, Kalra is hit on the pads. Way down the leg for the umpire to raise his finger after the lbw appeal was made.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
FOUR! Almost chops this onto his stumps. Back of a length ball, Kalra goes for the cut and the ball gets a fat inside edge to race away to the fine leg boundary.
Bouncer! Kalra ducks in time to let it through.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full again around off, Kalra hits this through mid off to rotate strike.
Full this time, Shaw drives this through covers for one.
SIX! First one of the day! Short ball, around off, Shaw rocks back and connects this well to hit it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Fuller this time, Kalra hits it through mid on for a run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Powerplay 2 time! You can now have a maximum of 4 fielders outside the ring. Skipper, Hasan Khan to continue...
This one is a clever little cutter outside off, Shaw commits himself early into the drive and misses.
Turns a length ball off his pads to the leg side, finds the fielder.
Digs in a bouncer, Shaw ducks.

Run out chance missed! Pakistan have been very poor in the field, so far. This is the third life granted to Kalra. He was dropped on 24, 29 and now on 30, he survives a run out chance. A length ball on off, Kalra taps it down to backward point and looks for a run. His partner is not interested and Manjot is midway down the track. The fielder though misses his shy at the striker's end and now they cross for a run.
Appeal for an lbw! This one just comes back in with the angle, Kalra stays back to defend but gets a big inside edge onto the pads. The umpire turns down the appeal immediately.
Back of a length delivery around off, Shaw remains back and runs it down to third man for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Floated ball, Shaw is beaten while trying to push this ball on the off side.
Drags his length back, Shaw punches this off his back foot on the off side to pick up two runs.
Muhammad Zaid moves out of the slip region. A couple of drops by him, the second being the tougher one but you need to catch those at this level.

DROPPED! Another one put down by Pakistan. This one slightly difficult but they have to take it. Tossed up ball, around off, Kalra goes forward to drive but gets an edge to it. The ball goes to first slip and Zaid drops the catch again. They run through.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Length, in line of the stumps, Kalra flicks it to the leg side for one.
Wide. This one is down the leg side and the batsman leaves it alone. The umpire has signalled a wide.
FOUR! Outside off again, Kalra slaps it over the backward point region and the ball bounces once to go to the fence. This will hurt Pakistan.
Kalra plays this to point.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
DROPPED! Two balls and two chances missed by Pakistan. Outside off, Kalra gets a thick edge to this. The ball flies to the slip fielder, who drops a regulation catch.

Afridi has missed the direct hit to give Shaw a life. Back of a length ball, Shaw jumps and plays it on the leg side. They run through and Afridi quickly gets to the ball to his right. He turns to have a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. Had he hit, Shaw was a goner.
Fuller this time and Shaw drives it through covers for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Short again, Shaw hits it on the off side for one.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
FOUR! Welcome to the crease, captain! Short ball around off, Shaw rocks back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Hasan Khan to roll his arm.
Kalra misses his cut on this and the keeper collects it.
Short again and Afridi gets good bounce on it. Kalra looks to cut it but is beaten.
Bouncer! Outside off, Kalra leaves it alone.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Shaw gets his second boundary. Length ball, outside off, Shaw flat bats this over point. The ball was in the air for sometime but far from the fielder. Another boundary for India.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Shaheen Afridi comes in to bowl.

FOUR! Makes full use of the Free Hit. Fuller length ball in the line of the stumps, Kalra gives room and slices it over the backward point region for back-to-back boundaries. 13 from the over, excellent for India!
FOUR! And a no-ball to make matters worse. Around off, overpitched and Kalra drives it through covers for a very good looking boundary. The ball races to the fence and a Free Hit up next.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Kalra defends it from within the crease.

Overpitched outside off, Kalra drives it to covers.
Length, way outside off. Kalra doesn't flirt with it.
Outside off, Kalra plays it to third man to retain strike for the next over.

Early signs that this pitch is excellent for stroke making. True bounce and it's coming on nicely to the bat. No help for the pacers, so far.
FOUR! Second of the innings! This time off the bat of Kalra. Short ball on middle and leg, Kalra waits for it and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of length ball, Shaw cuts it through point for another run.
Shaw has punched that ball through the off side.
Outside off, Kalra guides this to third man for one.
Around off, Kalra goes for the drive and is beaten.
Length ball, Kalra hits this to the covers.
Shaw cuts this ball to the point fielder.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings! Drags his length back a bit and Shaw jumps to cut this over point for a boundary.
Outside off, Kalra cuts it to third man for a quiet single.
Back of a length ball, Kalra misses his flick and the ball hits his thigh pad.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Muhammad Musa to bowl from the other end. He isn't express but very accurate. A slip for him too.

Uppish from Shaw. Around off, he cuts it past backward point and they come back for the brace. Shaheen the fielder in the deep overruns to his right initially but then recovers. Sends across a good throw to the keeper who takes the bails off and appeals. Nothing from the umpire as the batsmen are comfortably in for the second run.
Shaheen Afridi gives a quick autograph to one of the spectators. Good to see him getting his fair share of recognition.
Bouncer! Outside off, Shaw does well to evade it.
Fuller this time, almost yorked him. Shaw gets his bat down and plays it to the point fielder.
Back of a length ball and Shaw defends this off his back foot.
Similar ball. Around off and a solid defence from the captain.
Arshad Iqbal comes steaming in and starts off with a length ball around off. Good bounce off that and Shaw stays back to bunt it down.

It's time to play the game! Prithvi Shaw and Manjot Kalra are the Indian openers. The young Pakistani boys get into a quick huddle before spreading on the field. Arshad Iqbal to speed in with the first new ball. A single widish slip in place. Here we go...
A really special moment for these young boys as they walk out to the centre for the national anthems. Not much crowd so far but expect them to troop in big numbers as the day progresses.
Pakistan - Muhammad Zaid, Imran Shah, Rohail Nazir(w), Ali Zaryab, Mohammad Taha, Ammad Alam, Saad Khan, Hasan Khan(c), Muhammad Musa, Shaheen Afridi, Arshad Iqbal.
India - Prithvi Shaw(c), Manjot Kalra, Shubman Gill, Harvik Desai(w), Riyan Parag, Abhishek Sharma, Anukul Sudhakar Roy, Kamlesh Nagarkoti, Shivam Mavi, Shiva Singh, Ishan Porel.

Pitch - It's pretty dry, no real footmarks. You will get spin only if you are a very good spinner. Nothing much for the fast bowlers either and it will skid on nicely to the bat. A good call by India to bat first? Let's wait and watch. General notion is that you should always bat first in a pressure game.

Toss - India win the toss and elect to bat! Prithvi Shaw feels the pitch is good and the weather is fine, that's why they are batting. Informs that they are going unchanged and adds that it will be challenging to face Pakistan. Hasan Khan says that he would have batted also but it doesn't matter much now. Informs about one change, Imran Shah replaces Suleman Shafqat. Adds that they are really pumped up for this contest.

A final before the final! Yes, it's Pakistan vs India time in the U19 Cricket World Cup. The rivalry between these two sides are well known and we are expecting an electric bout. Both teams have impressed so far and have the required arsenal to trump each other. On one hand, we have India, who are invincible so far in this mega event and on the other hand, we have Pakistan, who after suffering an early blow have recovered superbly and are on a winning spree. As far as the head-to-head battle goes in U19 cricket, India hold the upper hand 12-8 but when it comes to U19 World Cup, Pakistan edge out the Boys in Blue 5-3. What will happen when these arch-rivals collide? Stay with us to find out...
